summary: youseethemoney ships a browser loader that executes unpinned remote code from a non-publisher GitHub account
details: The package declares a benign Hello-World index.html as its main entry, but also ships loader.html — a styled 'New Tab' page that fetches JavaScript from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/s0n-1m-cr1n3/sc13nc3/assets/load/ with a cascade of ~15 jsdelivr mirror hosts as fallbacks, then injects the response into the document via document.open. The GitHub source path is a leetspeak personal account unrelated to the npm publisher and is unpinned (no commit SHA or version), so the bytes returned are controlled by that account on every load and can be changed at any time. Any consumer that renders loader.html — for example a Chrome new-tab or HTML-based browser extension built on this package — executes whatever JavaScript that remote account currently serves. The decoy main entry hides the loader from casual review of the package's advertised purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
